asset: R-EP1-TOP-01_approved_author.png — AUTHOR-SUPPLIED final asset (supersedes v2): the pull-cord mechanism is built into the model — cord wound around the neck, exiting through a guide hole, wooden toggle handle at the end. Closed stapled seams, fabric patches, two seats retained.
mechanism: PULL-CORD START (canon; corrected 2026-08-07 — the earlier pump idea failed the scale check: the shaft grip sits at ~4in, at 4.5in Papa's chin, so no one can press down on it). The spiral groove on the central shaft is a WINDING THREAD: Papa winds a length of twine from his tool belt down the spiral (the groove seats each coil), plants his feet, grips the cord end two-handed at his own chest height, and YANKS horizontally like starting an outboard motor. The cord rips free and the striped body with its two seats spins up around the stationary shaft, carousel-around-a-pole. More speed = wind and yank again; a two-pull build is the animation beat. Riders hold their grab-handles and spin with the body. SH025's sharp wind-up plays as the wind-and-yank.
note: Horizontal pull at chest height is where a 4.5-inch man has real leverage; pull-string tops are period-native; the yank is a strength beat for Papa.
